notes: Identity verified independently from the supplied text: title A Choice Mind-Set Increases the Acceptance and Maintenance of Wealth Inequality; authors Krishna Savani and Aneeta Rattan; DOI 10.1177/0956797611434540; Psychological Science 23(7), 796–804, 2012.
